activity_summary: At midday the string was going away ahead of you. The bells were on the leader. Hobbins's back was in the dust. You were at the tail, where a man can talk to himself. No face was in it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in The string, and his back

entities.name: the spare nag

facets.activity: Walked at the tail, and let the string go ahead
